title: After Democratic Shake-Up, Susan Collins Holds Enormous Cash Edge in Maine
summary: Republicans are pouring huge sums behind the Maine senator through a web of billionaire-funded super PACs. Troy Jackson, picked as the new Democratic nominee, has a lot of catching up to do.
